title: He's Got the Whole World In His Hands
transcription:
He's Got the Whole World in His Hands

He's got the whole world
in His hands,
He's got the big, round world
in His hands,
He's got the wide world in His hands,
He's got the whole world
in His hands.

He's got the wind and the rain
in His hands,
He's got the sun and the moon
in His hands,
He's got the world and the rain
in His hands,
He's got the whole world
in His hands.

He's got the little bitty baby
in His hands,
He's got the little bitty baby
in His hands,
He's got the little bitty baby
in His hands,
He's got the whole world
in His hands.

He's got you and me, brother,
in His hands,
He's got you and me, brother,
in His hands,
He's got you and me, brother,
in His hands;
He's got the whole world in His hands.

He's got everybody here in His hands,
He's got everybody here in His hands,
He's got everybody here in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands.

He's got the whole world
in His hands,
He's got the whole wide world
in His hands,
He's got the whole world
in His hands,
He's got the whole world
in His hands.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from photographed page spread. Page heading is faint; title inferred from the visible spirituals continuing from prior spread.
